subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘TRIFLED’ is written as ‘YQNEQDI’ and ‘BRIEF’ is written as ‘GQNDK’. How will ‘FALTER’ be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] Logic : Alternately (5) is added to and (1) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series. So, • ‘TRIFLED’ is written as ‘YQNEQDI’
tags: Coding and Decoding By Letter Shifting
